label: Revcontent
terms_note: API access is switched on by the account representative; OAuth client credentials from Account Settings.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (client_id / client_secret under Account Settings → 'Stats API Credentials' → POST https://api.revcontent.io/oauth/token)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Revcontent Native API, OAuth2 client credentials).
auth: 1. Ask the Revcontent account representative to enable API access.
2. Account Settings → Stats API Credentials → client_id / client_secret.
reference.limits: - Enabled per account; free; Revcontent terms.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: client_id under Account Settings > 'Stats API Credentials' (API access is enabled by your Revcontent representative).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: client_secret from the same section; access tokens last 24 hours and are re-requested automatically.

me.note: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts?limit=1: confirms the Stats API credentials (Revcontent has no who-am-i call).

list_accounts.note: GET /stats/api/v1.0/sub_accounts/list_accounts: the sub accounts of the credential's account (user_id, email, status, permissions); the main account itself is not listed.

list_campaigns.note: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts (limit/offset; `status` filters the user status `enabled`: active or inactive). Campaigns of the credential's own account (account_id is not sent). `budget` is the daily budget in USD as a string (or 'unlimited'); raw.status is the system status and raw carries month-to-date cost, clicks and impressions.

get_report.note: GET /stats/api/v1.0/boosts/performance?date_from&date_to[&boost_id]: daily rows for one campaign, or aggregated over all campaigns when campaign_id is omitted. Values are strings; cost is USD.

update_budget.note: POST /stats/api/v1.0/boosts/{id}/settings {budget_type: daily, budget_amount}: daily budget in USD, minimum 50 (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Pacing defaults to on for daily budgets.

pause_resume.note: POST /stats/api/v1.0/boosts {id, enabled: off|on}. Resuming restarts spending.

evidence: host api.revcontent.io: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 6/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
